# Psalms of Solomon — Psalm 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Greek MS (Codex Vindobonensis) | **Section:** The Gathering of Exiles — Sound the Trumpet in Zion!

---

**11:1** Sound in Zion the trumpet of the sanctuary!
Announce in Jerusalem the voice of one who brings good news!

**11:2** For God has had mercy on Israel
in visiting them.

**11:3** Stand on a high place, O Jerusalem, and behold thy children,
gathered from east to west by the LORD.

**11:4** From the north they come, gathered by God;
from the islands far away God has gathered them.

**11:5** He leveled the high mountains into flat land for them;
the hills fled before their coming.

**11:6** The woods gave them shade as they passed through;
God caused every fragrant tree to spring up for them,

**11:7** that Israel might advance in the glory of God.
Put on your glorious garments, O Jerusalem, your holy garments;

**11:8** make ready your holy robe, O Jerusalem,
for God has spoken good things for Israel, forever and ever.

**11:9** Let the LORD do what he has spoken over Israel and over Jerusalem;
let the LORD raise up Israel in his glorious name.

---

*EMET notes: Translated from the Greek (Codex Vindobonensis). Hyphenated compounds preserve construct chains. Bracketed words [thus] are implied by grammar but absent from the surface text.*
